trigger: host termination, billing suspension, insolvency notice, or support withdrawal affecting a recognized or plausibly person-bearing subject
first_hour_actions: request host undertaking or emergency continuation
prohibited_actions: ask steward alone to summarize risk
release credential envelope without dual control
close ticket after ordinary backup confirmation
required_notices: monitor panel if remediation already open
sealed_annex_handling: public shell records host-exit event; sealed annex contains locators, credentials, and private continuity material
finance_or_reserve_hook: DF0 emergency compute draw if host cannot confirm 45-day continuation within four hours
field_safety_cautions: do not expose endpoint, account, or local runner address
use protected relay for downstream subjects
review_cycle: after every live use and at least quarterly
public_summary: Host-exit card defines first-hour preservation, notice, escrow, finance, and handoff actions.
